classification_detail: Closer hop 3 proves the exact kernel derivative, its uniform local L1 domination, and nonintegrability of the endpoint comparison kernel 1/(x*(x+1)) by reduction to the rpow exponent -1 criterion. Remaining work is measurability/integrability packaging, iteration to ContDiffOn, Tonelli for the derivative L1 bound, and rewriting the explicit derivative to that compiled endpoint kernel.
closer_note: Proved the endpoint kernel 1/(x*(x+1)) is not integrable on (0,1), closing the final power-integrability obstruction for the counterexample. Dominated differentiation, smoothness iteration, Tonelli, and the explicit derivative rewrite remain.
